2608.08910.title: Tied Trit-Planes: Constraining PTQTP to a Uniform Nine-Level Quantizer, with a Persistent Folded Format for Disk-Streamed Mixture-of-Experts Serving
2608.08910.paper_summary: PTQTP decomposes LLM weight matrices into two ternary (trit) planes with two free per-group scales. Tying the scales to a fixed ratio of three collapses the decomposition into a single uniform nine-level quantizer, a known balanced-ternary identity. To our knowledge, at the time of writing, this work is the first to impose that identity as a constraint inside PTQTP's solver. The two trit planes then fold losslessly into one 4-bit code plane that we make the persistent serving representation: disk bytes, expert-cache bytes, and kernel input are the same 4.0625-bits/weight blocks, consumed in one integer dot pass. For this conjunction (ratio-3 nine-level code, CPU-SIMD kernels, SSD expert streaming, identical persistent bytes) we likewise found no precedent. We apply this to the routed experts of DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, a 284B-A13B mixture-of-experts model, quantizing in one shot from the released MXFP4 expert weights and streaming experts from SSD on a 64 GB laptop. Against a 4.5-bit Q4_K baseline, measured one process per fixture with an expert-lossless anchor arm as reference control, the tied model matches the official serving API on 5/5 fixtures at step 0 (Q4_K: 4/5) and 12/14 captured continuation steps (11/14), scores 86 vs. 84 on a 100-item MMLU subset, decodes 6.7% faster in decode phase, and ships 9% smaller files: no detected fidelity difference at these small evaluation sizes, and every fixture-level difference between the arms traces to a single measured near-tie cell. The tied fit nevertheless shows higher weight-reconstruction error and worse perplexity, a measured dissociation between proxy metrics and reference fidelity. A cumulative trunk-ternarization ladder and bitwise-pinned aarch64/x86-64 kernels complete the report. All code, formats, and evaluation artifacts are open source in the fucina inference stack.
2608.08910.paper_summary_zh: PTQTP 將 LLM 權重矩陣分解為兩個三元（trit）平面，並為每組提供兩個自由比例。將比例綁定為固定的三比率，將分解壓縮為單一均勻的九級量化器，這是一個已知的平衡三元身份。據我們所知，在撰寫本文時，這項工作是第一個將該身份作為約束施加於 PTQTP 的求解器內部。然後，這兩個 trit 平面無損地折疊成一個 4 位元代碼平面，我們將其作為持久的服務表示：磁碟位元組、專家快取位元組和內核輸入都是相同的 4.0625 位元/權重區塊，在一次整數點乘中消耗。對於這種結合（比率-3 九級代碼、CPU-SIMD 內核、SSD 專家串流、相同的持久位元組），我們同樣未發現先例。我們將此應用於 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的路由專家，這是一個 284B-A13B 的專家混合模型，從發布的 MXFP4 專家權重中一次性量化，並在 64 GB 的筆記型電腦上從 SSD 串流專家。相較於 4.5 位元 Q4_K 基準，在每個裝置上測量一個過程，並以專家無損錨臂作為參考控制，綁定模型在第 0 步時在 5/5 裝置上匹配官方服務 API（Q4_K: 4/5），並在 12/14 捕獲的延續步驟中匹配（11/14），在 100 項 MMLU 子集上得分 86 對 84，在解碼階段解碼速度快 6.7%，並發送 9% 更小的檔案：在這些小型評估尺寸中未檢測到保真度差異，且每個裝置級別的臂之間的差異都追溯到單個測量的近乎平局單元。然而，綁定擬合顯示出更高的權重重建誤差和更差的困惑度，這是代理指標和參考保真度之間的測量解離。一個累積的幹三元化梯子和逐位固定的 aarch64/x86-64 內核完成了報告。所有代碼、格式和評估文物均在 fucina 推理堆疊中開源。
2608.08910.author: Matteo Grella et.al.
